meta.title: Recreate Order: Cancel button closes the Recreate Order window without creating an order
gaps: Assert that no success toast appears after cancellation without a known toast message or absence assertion for success toasts.
Assert that no order was created because no catalog step can inspect created orders or an order record.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that no success toast appears after cancellation without a known toast message or absence assertion for success toasts.; Assert that no order was created because no catalog step can inspect created orders or an order record.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared awarded event on its summary page.
Navigate to the awarded event's RFQ stage.
Open the RFQ Responses tab as required before accessing Settings.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Verify that cancellation closes the Recreate Order window.
